summary: A small fix: the red marks in the progress line sit on the line again.
notes: When you got a card wrong, its red mark at the top sat a little lower than the others. Now it lines up, during practice and on the results screen.

summary: A new way to practise: 書く, type the Japanese.
notes: 書く shows you the English meaning, and you type the Japanese word.
Type in romaji or in kana, whichever keyboard you have. Romaji turns into kana under the box as you type.
If you made a typo, tap “It was a typo” and the card counts as right.
Your own words need a reading to show up in 書く.

summary: On a day with nothing due, the suggestions work again.
notes: “Practise ahead” and “Recent mistakes” start their cards again. Before, tapping them did nothing.
“Practise ahead” now really is the cards due in the next two days, and each suggestion says how many cards it has.
“Next cards due” shows how many come next, and when.
If your streak ends, the app tells you once, and what you kept: your cards, your level and your schedule.
Settings → Diagnostics now names the right version when an update is waiting.

summary: Updates now tell you when they are ready.
notes: When a new version is ready, the app asks: update now, or later.
No more closing the app from the app switcher to get the latest version.
Every update comes with a short list like this one, including anything you skipped.
